The interpreter wasm is NOT in this directory. It rides an optional
gifos.assets pin (manifest.json) so the GIF stays a notebook you can
open before Python arrives:

  https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/pyodide/v0.27.7/full/pyodide.asm.wasm
    sha256 a50dd1843f805a0b7c45b61037ee0d7b26dfe85efe0e18ef95a34ad24e401f5f
    bytes  10105545

JupyterLite itself is the product this app is a port of
(https://github.com/jupyterlite/jupyterlite, BSD-3-Clause). The full
JupyterLab shell is not vendored — it is a webpack forest of relative
fetches and a service worker, which cannot run as a GifOS srcdoc.
The kernel is the same idea JupyterLite uses: CPython via Pyodide,
cells in one notebook, last-expression as Out. The notebook lives in
this file instead of IndexedDB.

Rebuild the four files above from those URLs and keep the hashes in
this file, build.mjs, and manifest.json in agreement.
